dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned structures exhibit thin, irregular perimeters with high-contrast transitions from the dark surrounding pelage to light perimeter lines; the centers of these structures show a secondary gradient back to a darker interior tone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid, high-intensity light-toned speckles lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the anterior-ventral region and scattered across the mid-lateral field.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent ring-like structures in the mid-lateral section form a rough trapezoidal geometry, with the base oriented parallel to the ventral-dorsal axis.
